name: Spirit Of Fear
overview: Scripture reveals that the spirit of fear is overcome by trusting in God's constant presence and strength. Believers are repeatedly urged to be strong and courageous, not fearing or being dismayed, because the Lord goes with them and will never forsake them (Deuteronomy 31:6; Joshua 1:9). The Psalms affirm that God's protection and deliverance remove fear, offering comfort even in the darkest trials (Psalms 23:4; 27:1; 34:4). Isaiah 41:10 further assures that God strengthens, helps, and upholds His people, providing the foundation for fearless faith.
